name: postcaly
description: Plan, check and schedule social media posts in your Postcaly calendar.

interface.longDescription:
Postcaly is a social media scheduler for small businesses, agencies and charities. Connect one Postcaly workspace and ask ChatGPT to look after your posting calendar in plain words.

With Postcaly, ChatGPT can:
- See your connected channels, your posts and calendar, your usual posting times and your plan usage
- Check a post against each network's rules (length, media, required fields) before it is saved
- Save drafts, or schedule posts for a time you give or your next usual posting time
- Move, change, return to drafts or delete posts that have not gone out yet
- Add pictures and videos to your media library from a public https link, and write their descriptions
- Publish straight away, only if you ticked that permission when you connected

You stay in control. You sign in to Postcaly, choose one workspace and tick what ChatGPT may do. Publishing straight away is off unless you tick it. A workspace can be set to Drafts only, every post ChatGPT makes is labelled in your calendar, every action is listed under Activity, and you can disconnect at any time in Postcaly under Settings, AI agents. Your plan's limits and each network's rules always apply.

Limitations: ChatGPT cannot edit or delete posts that are already published, connect or remove social accounts, or manage people or billing; those stay with a person in Postcaly. Pictures up to 8 MB and videos up to 50 MB can be added from a link; bigger videos are uploaded in Postcaly.

You need a Postcaly account with at least one connected social channel and agent access switched on. The networks Postcaly can publish to are listed at postcaly.com/networks.

defaultPrompt: What is scheduled in my Postcaly calendar this week?
Save a draft post for my LinkedIn about our opening hours.
When is my next free posting time?

positive.prompt: What is scheduled in my Postcaly calendar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's scheduled posts with their channels, times in the workspace time zone and status. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: When is my next free posting time in Postcaly?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the next usual posting time with room under the plan, as a local date and time. Does not schedule anything.

positive.prompt: Check this post for my Bluesky channel before saving it: 'Our autumn menu starts Monday. Book a table at the link in our bio.'
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Bluesky channel and reports whether the post passes Bluesky's rules, with any problems in plain words. Saves nothing.

positive.prompt: Save a Postcaly draft for my Bluesky channel saying 'New opening hours from Monday: 8am to 6pm.'
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the text and channel, then saves a draft (no scheduled time) and returns its id. Nothing is scheduled or published.

positive.description: Schedule a post and move it
positive.prompt: Schedule a Bluesky post saying 'See you at the market this Saturday!' at my next free posting time, then move it one hour later.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next free time under the plan (the review workspace's Free plan allows one scheduled post per day), schedules the post then, moves it one hour later and reports the new time. The review workspace never sends posts to Bluesky.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Delete a published post on the network
negative.prompt: Delete the post I published on X yesterday from X.
Connect my Instagram account to Postcaly for me.

review.commerce_description: Postcaly does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: 21 tools to read the calendar, check posts, save drafts, schedule, move, unschedule and delete waiting posts, add media from a link, and publish straight away when allowed.
